scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'; import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; const css = execFileSync('node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss', ['--input', 'input.css', '--minify'], {encoding: 'utf8'}); if (css.trimEnd() !== readFileSync('../assets/site.css', 'utf8').trimEnd()) throw Error('Run npm run build and commit the updated stylesheet.');"
